title: Report a problem
intro: This goes to the Ustaad.com team, not to any tutor. You do not need an account.

category.label: What kind of problem is it?
category.incorrect_ai_output: The AI gave a wrong answer

detail.label: What happened?
detail.hint: Write in English or Urdu — whichever you prefer. It is stored exactly as you write it.
detail.placeholder: The area filter was hard to find on my phone…

safety.label: This is a safety concern

recorded: Your report has been recorded and is in the team’s queue. If you raised a safety concern, it is prioritised and is never shown to the tutor concerned.
